verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair axis for an observability platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a scheduler, recurring workflow triggers, or cron-style automation in Datadog. The Monitors, Dashboards, API, MCP server and CLI items describe other capabilities, not scheduled recurring execution. Absent evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
